messages:
nia (Finance Ops): Orbitron Systems (ORBT-909) is 37 days past due on INV-2025-03-02 for $61,450. Two reminder emails, no reply. Recommending payment plan + pause on extra seats if no response in 48h.

logan (Acct Mgmt): Ugh. Sales onboarded a new pilot last month; hold could impact that. I reached out to their CFO yesterday via LinkedIn.

billing-bot: invoice INV-2025-03-02 — status: DUE 37d — balance $61,450 — last_attempt: 2025-04-08T10:21:00Z — failure_code: R03 (invalid_account)

teri (Revenue Ops): Suggest a 2-pay split: 40% now, 60% in 30 days. Require wire or verified ACH; autopay required for remainder. Add acceleration clause on missed payment.

nia (Finance Ops): Draft terms below. Will not remove pause on seats until first payment clears.

--- DRAFT ---
Orbitron Systems Payment Proposal
Invoice: INV-2025-03-02
Total: $61,450
Payment schedule:
  - 40% ($24,580) due within 48 hours by wire/verified ACH
  - 60% ($36,870) due in 30 days via autopay (wire/ACH)
Terms: Missed installment = immediate acceleration of full outstanding balance; 12% collection fee + interest 1.25%/mo. Billable seats/features paused until initial payment posts. Reply to accept or request call within 48h.
--- END ---

logan (Acct Mgmt): Language ok. Maybe offer exception for 35% upfront if they can provide a card-on-file guarantee? Avoid card for this amt unless escrow.

frank (Legal): No card at this volume without escrow or corporate guarantee. Keep wire/ACH only. Add recovery of reasonable collection costs and attorneys' fees.

nia (Finance Ops): Sent proposal to CFO at 2025-04-10T14:05Z, copied Legal. 48h window.

(2025-04-11T09:10Z) orbit-cfo (external): Thanks. We had an internal signatory change which delayed payment. Can do 35% wire today and the rest in 45 days. Also disputing ~10% of the invoice for alleged overages; want credit consideration.

neri (typo): ignore

teri (Revenue Ops): 35% is lower than our ask. If they wire 40% today and sign amendment we can accept 40/60. On dispute, we need a reconciliation doc before any credit.

logan (Acct Mgmt): I'll get usage logs from billing and share a reconciliation template with them. No credits until we confirm overage math.

billing-bot: note: usage report for ORBT-909 generated 2025-04-11T10:00Z (link: /reports/orbt-909-usage-2025-03).

orbit-cfo (external): Wire initiated for $24,580 (ref W-55621). Sending remittance. For the dispute, we'll review logs once you send template.

nia (Finance Ops): Wire confirmed and posted 2025-04-11T15:20Z. Remaining balance $36,870. Preparing amendment for signature: remaining due in 30 days; dispute review to be completed within 10 business days and any agreed credit applied to final installment only.

last action: 2025-04-12T08:45Z  logan: tasked with sending reconciliation template and scheduling a 30-min call to close dispute and confirm amendment signature.
